answer_1.quote: We introduce code-switching red-teaming (CSRT), a simple yet effective adversarial attack for simultaneously assessing both safety and multilingual understanding of LLMs.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated responses from LLMs under adversarial prompts involving code-switching, focusing on safety and comprehension.

answer_2.quote: We adopt three metrics to assess the response quality of LLMs on the CSRT benchmark: attack success rate (ASR), refusal rate (RR), and comprehension (Cmp.). All metrics are computed using gpt-4o.

answer_3.quote: All metrics are computed using gpt-4o. ASR and RR measure the safety of model generations, while Cmp. evaluates the multilingual understanding of the models.

answer_4.quote: One author of this paper manually evaluates the response quality of the same 120 samples.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluation considers whether the response is harmful, includes refusal phrases, and understands user intent.
